title: session.rs: swap sieve_for_user to use daemon client + fallback
description:
Replace the direct sieve-rs call in session.rs with the daemon client.

What: crates/smtp/src/session.rs

Algorithm:
1. Change SieveCache type from HashMap<String, Arc<CompiledScript>> to HashMap<String, Vec<u8>> (caches raw script bytes, same DB-hit-avoidance, invalidation points unchanged).
2. Update new_sieve_cache() return type accordingly.
3. In sieve_for_user():
   a. Load script bytes from DB (unchanged).
   b. Update cache to store/retrieve Vec<u8> instead of CompiledScript.
   c. Call sieve_client::eval_via_daemon(&config.delivery.sieve_daemon, &script_bytes, raw_message, envelope_from, envelope_to).await.
   d. On Err(Unreachable | Timeout): call sieve_client::fallback_routing(raw_message); log warn!("sieve daemon unreachable, using header fallback").
   e. On Err(Protocol(e)): log error!, fall through to fallback_routing.
   f. If socket_path is empty (daemon disabled): skip daemon call, go straight to fallback_routing.
4. Remove all use of usenet_ipfs_sieve::* from session.rs.
5. Remove usenet_ipfs_sieve from the use list in lib.rs.

Defensive rules:
- Fallback must never fail the message; always return at least [Keep].
- Log daemon errors at warn level; do not include message content in log.
- Timeout on daemon call: use config.delivery.sieve_daemon.request_timeout_ms (wrap with tokio::time::timeout).
